results.headline: Quarterly Update to 30 September 2026

results.summary: Metals Exploration reported Q3 2026 results ahead of expectations. Free cash flow increased to US$34.5m (Q2: US$25.2m) and gold revenue rose to US$57.7m (Q2: US$47.1m). However, La India construction delayed to Q1 2027 from December 2026 due to cable theft, though overall construction is 75% complete. A tragic fatal incident occurred post-quarter-end at La India site.

results.summary: Drilling update at Clontibret reports results from deep drill hole CGC-25-007 that intersected the targeted stockwork zone as predicted by the geological model. Results align with geological expectations and support the company's interpretation of the gold system, but no comparison is made to market or analyst expectations, and no guidance is provided or updated.
